text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.2694 for the Senior Full Stack Software Developer position. The strongest evidence for their candidacy is their experience with "REST API", alongside listed experience in Node.js, SQL, Docker, and AWS. Key gaps include missing requirements for ruby, reactjs, git, and ci/cd, as well as having less than the preferred seven years of experience. Despite these missing must-have skills and a low overall fit, the application has been escalated for further review.
